release_notes:
Stable build for Waze **5.28.4.900**. 38 rows.

Two additions, both off by default. Nothing changes for an existing setup until you switch them on in the gear page.

**Unlock driver moods — *Keep my mood after a restart***
Waze re-applies the mood from your account profile every time it starts, so a mood the account does not own (any of the unlocked special moods) is replaced on the next launch. With the switch on, the mood you pick is written into Waze's own config store and put back on every mood refresh. **Status: experimental and not yet confirmed working.** The first tester who ticked the switch still saw the mood revert to default after a restart (issue #25, comment of 26 Nov), so treat this as a first attempt, not a fix.

**Accept AARE as car host** (new row, Android Auto)
Waze validates the host that connects to its car surface and only accepts Google's projection app. The row turns that validation off, so AARE and other non-Google hosts can open Waze's car screen. It flips one config value that `WazeCarAppService.createHostValidator` already reads — no library code is touched and a normal Android Auto session is unaffected. Because it accepts any host while enabled, it stays off by default.

**Verified before publishing**
- every one of the 38 rows applies on 5.28.4.900: 38/38, 0 failed
- 466,087 methods scanned, 0 broken branch targets
- 86/86 forced config keys reach the native store, not just the Java getter
- with the defaults (no options), neither new feature is present in the patched app: host validation untouched, no mood helpers
- with the mood switch on, the two helpers are present and hooked at the picker setter and the mood refresh
- behavioural proof for the mood switch is missing: one tester reported a reset with the switch enabled
- bundle re-downloaded after upload and re-applied: 38/38

Older Waze builds are not covered: 5.27.90.900 stays on **0.30.64**.
